steps.what: Direct actual traffic counting, resolve field problems and capture actual collection exceptions
inputs: actual crew observations and counter performance

tasks.design: Configure native station, interval and classification mappings in {TRAFFIC_COUNT_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. The planner still designs the program, directs actual counting and judges gaps. A separate native import reconciliation reduces residual file alignment. Final crew instructions and the final count record each precede their own gated send or save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counter exports may still require repeated station and interval alignment.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable native traffic count import mappings can retain exact source periods and station identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, faulty counters, atypical days and unsafe field conditions require actual supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The planner decides whether counts describe the intended urban traffic conditions.
tasks.altitude: Direct the counting program with less repeated file reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: traffic count systems can import station and interval files; this local mapping design is proposed.

assumptions: All shares and remaining effort are provisional. Observe residual manual alignment after existing counter downloads and reports; existing recording and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual counters or crew produce station_id, interval_start, interval_end, class and count. The planner captures exceptions and checks actual collection scope in s4 at full time; s5 retains 12.5 hours for import exceptions and coverage checks. Missing compatible files use manual reconciliation.

The final plan exists before s3; the actual count record exists before s7. Changed instructions or recipients require renewed approval. The 1% save is retained at full effort for graph granularity and earns no saving.
research_questions: Which manual interval and station reconciliations remain after current counter imports?

incremental.description: Maintain station and classification mappings against actual equipment changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only s5 changes: 25 times 50% = 12.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 11.5. Low halves that benefit: 6.25 less 1 = 5.25. Saves and sends earn no benefit.

tasks.short: Represent jurisdictions in legislative or administrative approval of land development projects.

steps.what: Retrieve current development plans, jurisdiction positions and approval history using a native case view
outputs: planner-checked case evidence and current jurisdiction position

steps.what: Prepare and approve the final authorised jurisdiction statement and supporting material
inputs: planner-checked case evidence and current jurisdiction position
outputs: approved final jurisdiction statement, materials and intended approval body

steps.what: Represent the jurisdiction at actual legislative or administrative land development approval proceedings
inputs: approved final jurisdiction statement, materials and intended approval body

steps.what: Write and approve the actual proceedings record and complete final follow-up statement
outputs: approved final proceedings record and follow-up statement with exact approval body recipient

steps.what: Save the approved final proceedings record
inputs: approved final proceedings record and follow-up statement with exact approval body recipient

steps.what: Send the approved final follow-up statement to its approved external approval body
inputs: approved final proceedings record and follow-up statement with exact approval body recipient
outputs: sent final land development follow-up statement

tasks.design: Configure a native project case view in {LAND_DEVELOPMENT_CASE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER, to expose actual plan versions, jurisdiction decisions and approval history. The planner verifies authority and prepares the statement personally. Representation, the actual proceedings note, its save and a final follow-up send remain distinct full-effort work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current plans and prior jurisdiction positions may be scattered across case attachments.
tasks.enabler_now: A native case view can gather current version links and decision history without generating policy advice.
tasks.still_hard: Representing an authorised position while responding to actual questions and contested interests.
tasks.human_edge: The planner understands the jurisdiction mandate and the practical meaning of proposed development conditions.
tasks.altitude: More accessible case evidence for human representation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: development case systems can display versioned documents and decision history; this native view is a proposed configuration.

assumptions: All shares and remaining effort are provisional. Verify residual document retrieval after existing case views; current search and automatic versioning earn no new benefit.
The actual case owner supplies case_id, document_version and decision_date. s1 retains 9 hours to verify authority, version currency and missing attachments; missing records are retrieved manually.

s2 approves the complete final statement before representation. New commitments outside the mandate pause for authorised review. s4 writes actual outcomes, not predicted approvals, and approves exact follow-up text and recipient before each separate action. Same-system saves earn no benefit.
research_questions: Which plan and jurisdiction-position retrieval remains manual after the current case view?

incremental.description: Maintain case view document and authority mappings
